text:
zoe: heads-up — kicking off a layer-slim pivot tomorrow 23:00 PT. scope: squash layers, remove build caches, rebuild minimal base, sign artifacts with a dedicated key. need RBAC + audit checklist before we flip.
pranav: i can own the signing key. prefer a new asymmetric key (ECDSA_P256) tagged signing:base-pivot. we should NOT grant kms:Decrypt to CI.
luca: CI will need kms:Sign and kms:GetPublicKey for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-builder. add conditions: IpAddress for build subnet and RequestTag env=prod-builder.
sec-bot: reminder: all Sign events must be recorded in CloudTrail and forwarded to s3://redwood-audit/images/signs/ and SIEM. retention=365d. open SEC ticket SEC-9017 for RBAC/key changes.
zoe: pranav, paste the minimal policy snippet so infra can preflight.
pranav: minimal snippet (pseudo):
```
Statement: Allow
  Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-builder
  Action: [kms:Sign, kms:GetPublicKey]
  Condition: IpAddress 10.2.0.0/16 && StringEquals aws:RequestTag/env prod-builder
```
luca: also add a cosign verify step in the deploy template: `for img in $IMAGES; do cosign verify --key $COSIGN_KEY_URI $img || exit 1; done`
zoe: vuln note: scanner flagged CVE-2026-3344 (openssl) in a sidecar image. plan: pin distro packages and rebuild minimal image. who will own the vuln PR?
luca: i'll take the Dockerfile PR. will add automated checks: seccomp, non-root user validation, and userns mapping smoke tests. also ensure image manifest includes provenance.signatures[].keyId and keyUri.
oncall: runbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ops/pages/LAYER-PIVOT-RUNBOOK. if signing fails revert tags and open #release-war-room. oncall standing by.
sec-bot: policy note: any RBAC edits must be recorded in SEC-9017 with justification and a rollback window. escape hatch: offline signing is allowed only with sec-admin approval and full forensics. ephemeral keys should be tagged ephemeral:true and TTL set.
zoe: tentative timeline: 23:00 build+sign, 23:20 canary deploy, 00:00 validation, 00:30 full cutover. i'll create SEC-9017 and attach the checklist + key ARN when ready. ping here at 22:30 PT for final preflight. :shipit:
